name: Horn section hits
desc: Brass-section hits and answers in Bb mixolydian: tight unison stabs on the one and the and-of-four, with a rising three-note answer riff every other bar. Layered saw+square with punchy attack and fast decay, Earth Wind & Fire horn-chart feel.
